summary: A superb Blitz, but too punishing as a daily: famous cities that are small inside city limits (San Francisco, Miami, Boston, Atlanta, Seattle) each cost a life, and the casual player ran out of lives on guess 13 with 8 found.
reasons: Casual found New York, LA, Chicago, Houston, Philadelphia, Dallas, Phoenix and San Diego, but San Francisco (#17), Miami (#41), Boston (#25), Atlanta (#36) and Seattle (#18) took all five lives by guess 13, before San Antonio was tried. '(city proper)' is an honest warning, but a typical player can't tell which famous cities are small.

Fan got 10/10 but lost 3 lives on #10, a four-way race within 4% (Fort Worth, Jacksonville, Austin, San Jose). With these runs the synthetic crowd averages about 6.8, so the list isn't too hard, just punishing.
Values match the 2025 estimates on the source page, and short forms work (nyc, la, philly, ft worth, sf, dc, vegas, jax). Blitz is excellent: all 20 quick casual names scored.
fixes: Junk aliases on #5 Phoenix (redirects that are not names of the city): 'Macayo's', 'Garcia's', 'Manuel's', 'Monti's La Casa Vieja', 'Jim Favorite', 'John A. Chenowth', 'Benjamin Fowler', 'Tom Barnum', 'Wendell Burnette', 'Archway Veritas', 'Haver Home', 'Arizona Opera Center', 'Dorrance Theater', 'Centre Dance Ensemble', 'ITheatre Collaborative', 'Arizona Military Museum', 'Hall of Flame Firefighting Museum', 'Pueblo Grande Indian Market', 'Grand Menorah Lighting', 'Scottish Gathering & Highland Games', 'Tohono O'odham Nation Rodeo & Fair', 'The Phoenix Charter Bill', 'Phoenix Herald', 'John C. Lincoln North Mountain Hospital', 'Kidnapping capital of the USA'. Today 'garcia's' counts as Phoenix.

Junk aliases on other top-10 entries: Houston 'White Oak Music Hall' (it counts as Houston today); Dallas 'Lake Cliff Park'; Fort Worth 'Fort Worth Press', 'Avondale, Texas', 'Lake Crest Estates', 'Lake Crest Estates, Texas'; Philadelphia 'Philadelphia Commuter Rail', 'Philadelphia Regional Rail', 'Philadelphia Suburban Rail', 'Philadelphia City Controller', 'Philadelphia Artists Equity'; Chicago 'Chicago theatre scene', 'Chicago Finance Committee', 'Chicago Transportation Committee'; San Antonio 'Edible San Antonio', 'San Antonio Report'; New York 'New york immigrants', 'Immigration to New York'; Los Angeles 'Northern Los Angeles', 'Thenard, California'.
'Leningrad' is an alias of #87 St. Petersburg (Florida) and costs a life; it belongs to the Russian city. Drop it.

Ranks 11+ have no state-code or 'Saint' forms, so 'seattle wa', 'boston ma', 'austin tx', 'kansas city mo', 'saint paul' (#69, the city's official name), 'saint george' (#287) and 'port saint lucie' (#86) are told they are not on the list. Add '<City> <ST>' and 'Saint' variants for every row, as the top 10 already have.

The 14 smaller same-named cities in the source (Columbus GA, Glendale CA, Aurora IL, Kansas City KS, Springfield MA and IL, Lakewood NJ, Pasadena CA, Columbia MO, Rochester MN, Richmond CA, Concord NC, Peoria IL, Fayetteville AR) are dropped and the rest renumbered, so every rank from #124 down is 1 to 14 places off the source order (Knoxville shows #124, source #125). Keep source ranks, or keep those rows under state-qualified names.
